rule.section: VALIDATION_SPEC.md 6.4 (TS comparison: heavy-atom graph isomorphism + mirror-aware Kabsch RMSD; same TS)

qc.n_label_order_below_mapped_note: finite mapped RMSD only (inf = no isomorphism: n_inf / heavy_graph_isomorphic)

same_ts_downstream.decision: C-13: option (b), the recommended one (user rule); deviation from the literal spec 7 'G2 = DFT TS'
consumers: D1G2 Phase A 10 (same / different TS split)

notes: same_ts_dft = the VALIDATION_SPEC 6.4 rule as is, G2 (xTB) vs the label DFT TS: the 0.02 A forming criterion crosses levels of theory; g1_vs_dft_baseline = the same rule on the identical TS carried to xTB (G1), i.e. what the rule gives for 'same TS' across the level shift. same_ts_g1 is the level-matched comparison (decisions C-6, C-13).

the 'same TS' judgment for the headline, Phase A, Phase R and D1LADDER E2 is same_ts_g1 (decision C-13, deviation from the literal spec 7 wording); empty = not classified (G2 not ok or no G1 .done). same_ts_dft = the literal rule (G2 vs DFT TS), kept for reference.
rmsd 'inf' = no heavy-atom graph isomorphism under fragmenter.heavy_graph (factor 1.25).
decisions: C-1 rule source = the D1 runtime copy of rmsd.py: its fragmenter (EDA-ASM/analysis/espley_xtb_repro) has Si in COV / Z (the D1PAIR Si decision, 1.11 A); the main-worktree fragmenter has no Si (KeyError on the SiMe3 rows). rmsd.py itself is byte-identical in both places.
C-2 thresholds from config_val.yaml prereg.same_ts (0.10 / 0.02), verified against rmsd.same_ts defaults and the spec.

C-3 forming distances: computed from each structure's ts.xyz at the label formed_pairs_ts (0-based, label order; G2 / G1 ts.xyz are in label atom order), cross-checked against the records (label formed_d1/2, result.json d_form_g2 / d_form_g1: *_record_dev); same_ts compares them sorted (rmsd.same_ts). If a G2 element order differed from the label (never expected; g2_syms_match False) the result.json d_form_g2 is used instead (also when the DFT TS could not be read: *_syms_match empty, the row carries a 'dft:' error).
C-4 argument order a = G2 (G1 in the calibration), b = the reference (DFT TS / G1), as the validation (run vs Coley).
C-5 G2 compared only when G_status.csv status is ok (and .done present; else row error); G1 = g1_final/<rxn_id>/.done.

C-6 level-shift baseline: G2 is an xTB TS and the DFT TS is DFT, so the 0.02 A forming criterion also measures the method shift (d1_pair results/G_g1_summary.csv, G1's own metrics for the SAME TS re-optimised with xTB, 8,367 ok: |dd_form| <= 0.02 A for both bonds 179, rmsd_ts_heavy_A <= 0.10 A 3,030, both 88; the shift is scatter, not an offset: dd_form_short signed median +0.003 A, |dd_form_short| median 0.07 A, |dd_form_long| median 0.09 A, same-order heavy RMSD median 0.13 A). same_ts_dft is kept exactly as the rule says (spec 7 / 13: no threshold change); G1 vs DFT with the same rule is reported next to it (extra columns / g1_vs_dft_baseline / g1_vs_dft_same_rows), and G2 = G1 is the level-matched (xTB vs xTB) comparison. Not recalibrated (option (c), new thresholds, would be a method change; not taken).
C-7 the two rule components (RMSD <= 0.10, forming <= 0.02) are reported as separate pass fractions (decomposition of the same rule, not a new criterion).

C-8 fractions with Wilson 95 % CI (validation stats.wilson, VALIDATION_SPEC 6.5); distributions: finite values (linear percentiles 10/25/50/75/90) + n_inf (no isomorphism) + median_all / p90_all with inf kept (inverted_cdf).
C-9 groups: full blocks by dipole, skeleton, dipole/skeleton, core, regio, panel, series, attach, face, stereo_index, stage; compact counts by R1, R2 and cell_id (81 / 82 / 5,047 values).

C-10 G2-failed profile: failure category = G_status status (method / pipeline) and the first fail reason; by the same fields + R1 / R2 (substituents) + elements (DFT ts.xyz symbols) + n_atoms bins (<=15, 16-20, 21-25, 26-30, 31-40, >40) + label flags; numeric medians ok vs failed; G1 status of the failed rows.

C-11 inputs: labels = $G2/G/labels_d1_g2.json (prep_g.py, verbatim labels_d1.json rows), checked row-equal to g2_common.targets() and to X_targets / G_status (job_id, rxn_id, dipole, skeleton); mismatch = STOP.
C-12 strict JSON summary (NaN -> null, inf -> "inf"); summary built from the CSV re-read (what E2 will read).

C-13 the "same TS" judgment used downstream (summary headline, Phase A split of 10, Phase R sentence 2, D1LADDER 12 E2 split) = same_ts_g1: G2 vs G1, both xTB, the same rule and thresholds. Option (b) of the builder's three (a: literal same_ts_dft, b: same_ts_g1, c: new thresholds), the recommended one (user: every judgment = the recommended option). Reason: same_ts_dft crosses the xTB / DFT level and calls the identical TS 'different' in ~99 % of rows (C-6), so it cannot separate "G2 found the label's TS" from "G2 found another TS"; G1 is the label TS carried to the xTB surface. This deviates from the literal spec 7 wording ("G2 = DFT TS"): recorded in C_summary.json same_ts_downstream and reported; same_ts_dft stays in the CSV unchanged. Coverage: same_ts_g1 is empty (not classified, never counted as same or different) where G2 is not ok or G1 has no .done (607 'rest' targets have no G1, 292 G1 runs failed).
